mapper.sql: id, shop_id, promotion_enabled, balance_reminder_enabled, strategy_config_json, strategy_configured, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mt_promotion_setting WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mt_promotion_setting WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM mt_promotion_setting WHERE shop_id IN
#{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mt_promotion_setting SET shop_id = #{shopId}, promotion_enabled = #{promotionEnabled}, balance_reminder_enabled = #{balanceReminderEnabled}, strategy_config_json = #{strategyConfigJson}, strategy_configured = #{strategyConfigured}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS setting_id, s.shop_id, COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name) AS shop_name, sh.poi_id, sh.shipping_time, s.strategy_config_json, t.access_token, t.expires_at AS token_expires_at FROM mt_promotion_setting s INNER JOIN mt_shop sh ON sh.id = s.shop_id INNER JOIN mt_access_token t ON t.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE s.promotion_enabled = 1 AND s.strategy_configured = 1 AND s.strategy_config_json IS NOT NULL AND s.strategy_config_json != '' AND t.access_token IS NOT NULL AND t.access_token != '' AND t.auth_status = 1 AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at > #{now}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mt_shop_right r WHERE r.shop_id = s.shop_id AND r.service_code IN ('H5_PROMOTION', 'VIP_CODE') AND ( (r.type = 2 AND r.expire_at IS NOT NULL AND r.expire_at > #{now}) OR (r.type != 2 AND r.remaining_times IS NOT NULL AND r.remaining_times > 0) ) ) ORDER BY s.shop_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT s.shop_id FROM mt_promotion_setting s WHERE s.strategy_configured = 1 AND s.strategy_config_json IS NOT NULL AND s.strategy_config_json != '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mt_shop_right r WHERE r.shop_id = s.shop_id AND r.service_code IN ('H5_PROMOTION', 'VIP_CODE') AND ( (r.type = 2 AND r.expire_at IS NOT NULL AND r.expire_at > #{now}) OR (r.type != 2 AND r.remaining_times IS NOT NULL AND r.remaining_times > 0) ) ) ORDER BY s.shop_id ASC
